um I guess maybe the answer is 2/6? I am not really sure about this one though

You got the first one right! We multiply by 2.

The bottom numbers are the same. 

What do we do with the top numbers?
Is it 6/18? I am not really sure if we add the bottom numbers too.

We do not add the bottom numbers. 

They stay the same. 

The bottom number is 9. 

Now, just add the top numbers. 

What is 2 plus 4?
6/9 because you keep the bottom number the same and just add 2 and 4 on top Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Spot on! You are doing great.

Now we have 1 over 4 plus 1 over 8. 

The bottom numbers are different. 

Can you make the 4 turn into an 8? 

What do we multiply 4 by?
is it 2/12? i just added the top numbers and bottom numbers together, but i am really not sure about it

That is a common trick. 

Do not add the bottoms. 

We must make the bottoms match first. 

We want 4 to be 8. 

What times 4 gives 8?
